preconditions.description: The number of cities, n, is between 1 and 300,000, inclusive.
The number of roads, m, is between 0 and n-1, inclusive.
The number of queries, q, is between 1 and 300,000, inclusive.
The cities connected by each road are numbered between 1 and n, inclusive.
No road connects a city to itself.

postconditions.expression: output[i] is the length of the longest path in the region that contains city xi for each event of the first type
postconditions.description: The output for each query of the first type should be the length of the longest path in the region containing the specified city.
